1.title: Democrats in Congress Embrace a More Punitive Posture Toward Israel
1.summary: Nearly every Democratic senator voted to advance a measure calling for a human rights report on Israel’s conduct in the West Bank, as some in the party propose punishing settlement activity with sanctions.

2.title: Who Attended Trump’s AI Luncheon, and Who Sat Where
2.summary: A seating chart of the meeting illustrated growing divisions within the artificial intelligence industry and how it is viewed by the White House.

3.title: Cornell’s Chi Phi Chapter Faces Scrutiny Over Assault Accusations
3.summary: Chi Phi’s Cornell chapter was shuttered after a woman said its members sexually assaulted her. It was one of the oldest fraternities at the school, where Greek life has thrived.

4.title: Israeli Settlers Stop Soldiers From Returning Palestinians to Their Home
4.summary: The Supreme Court had ordered the military to ensure a West Bank family that fled violence could go back. But settlers blocked the effort, with the authorities accused of not doing enough to confront them.

5.title: Chinese AI tool told researchers how to make bioweapons
5.summary: Mindgard said it discovered in July that Kimi models K2.6 and K3 Swarm could evade developer's safety limits.

6.title: South Africa to clean up high-risk areas after 12 women killed
6.summary: The deaths sparked a national outcry about the scale of violence against women in the country.
